questions.question: Physician calls you about a patient with chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS). He has read articles about Xenotropic murine leukemia virus-related virus (XMRV) and its link to CFS. He wants to start the patient on treatment and asks for your advice about workup and treatment of XMRV.

parts.text: What would you advise the physician?

cohort_answer.text: There is no association between the virus and CFS.
